MARRIAGE

noun

MARRIAGE is one of one hundred entries in this pocket edition of The Devil’s Dictionary. The headword is eight letters long. Spell it out of the grid, and the line below is what the dictionary reads back.

The state or condition of a community consisting of a master, a mistress and two slaves, making in all, two.

55 definitions in this edition are quoted from Ambrose Bierce’s The Devil’s Dictionary (1911), which is in the public domain. Quotations from that book are reproduced as published, including period spellings and period opinions. The other 45 were written for this game in the same voice.
